ruleset.name: calculator-cirrus-test-antipatterns
ruleset.description: The textual half of the test-antipattern gate: a test may not assert on the characters of a source file, on a copied source snippet, on indentation, or on text that is named like source. Everything that needs a resolved type or method-local data flow is an Error Prone check in cloudlang-plugin/cloudtestplugin instead.

rule.name: TestReadsProductionSources
rule.message: 读了产品源码文件 {0}。实现改名或格式化就会误报，而真实行为回归它测不出来。改为断言被测 API 的返回值或状态；需要内部状态时用 dev.vfyjxf.cirrus.testutil.Reflect。
rule.description: Reading src/main text asserts that a file contains characters, not that the code behaves: a rename or a reformat turns it red while a behavioural regression keeps it green. Assert on the value the source produces, or read internals through the shared Reflect helper.

rule.name: TestStringContainsOnSourceText
rule.message: 对名为 {0} 的文本做了 contains/startsWith 断言。文本内容不代表行为，改一行注释就可能假绿或假红。改为断言解析后的对象或组件树。
rule.description: A substring check whose receiver is named like file text asserts on source characters. It cannot see behaviour and breaks on reformatting. Resolve what the text would have been parsed into and assert on that object.

rule.name: TestAssertsIndentation
rule.message: 断言里的字符串 {0} 带缩进或制表符。格式由 Spotless 负责，断言缩进只会因重排而误报。改为断言解析出的值。
rule.description: A literal carrying a tab or a run of spaces together with a semicolon is an embedded source snippet whose formatting is being compared. Indentation is the formatter's job; assert the parsed value.

property.name: xpath
property.value: (//MethodCall[matches(@MethodName, '^(assert|verify|expect|should|fail)')] [not(@MethodName = ('assertEquals', 'assertNotEquals', 'assertArrayEquals', 'assertIterableEquals', 'assertLinesMatch'))] /ArgumentList/*[1]/descendant-or-self::StringLiteral [matches(string(@ConstValue), '[\t]|\s\s')][contains(string(@ConstValue), ';')] [not(ancestor-or-self::* [ModifierList/Annotation[@SimpleName = 'AllowWeakTest'] [count(tokenize(normalize-space(.//MemberValuePair[@Image = 'reason']/StringLiteral/@ConstValue), ' ')) >= 20] [every $c in string-to-codepoints(string(.//MemberValuePair[@Image = 'reason']/StringLiteral/@ConstValue)) satisfies ($c >= 32 and $c <= 126)] [.//MemberValuePair[@Image = 'rules']//StringLiteral[string(@ConstValue) = 'TestAssertsIndentation']]])] | //MethodCall[@MethodName = ('assertEquals', 'assertNotEquals')] /ArgumentList/*[position() <= 2]/descendant-or-self::StringLiteral [matches(string(@ConstValue), '[\t]|\s\s')][contains(string(@ConstValue), ';')] [not(ancestor-or-self::* [ModifierList/Annotation[@SimpleName = 'AllowWeakTest'] [count(tokenize(normalize-space(.//MemberValuePair[@Image = 'reason']/StringLiteral/@ConstValue), ' ')) >= 20] [every $c in string-to-codepoints(string(.//MemberValuePair[@Image = 'reason']/StringLiteral/@ConstValue)) satisfies ($c >= 32 and $c <= 126)] [.//MemberValuePair[@Image = 'rules']//StringLiteral[string(@ConstValue) = 'TestAssertsIndentation']]])])

rule.name: TestAssertsSourceSnippet
rule.message: 断言里的字符串 {0} 是一段源码。断言源码文本在重构后必然失效，且测不到运行时行为。改为断言被调用 API 的输出。
rule.description: A literal of 24+ characters containing a semicolon, an arrow or a call is copied Java. Comparing against it re-implements the compiler inside the test and dies on every refactor.

property.name: xpath
property.value: (//MethodCall[matches(@MethodName, '^(assert|verify|expect|should|fail)')] [not(@MethodName = ('assertEquals', 'assertNotEquals', 'assertArrayEquals', 'assertIterableEquals', 'assertLinesMatch'))] /ArgumentList/*[1]/descendant-or-self::StringLiteral [string-length(string(@ConstValue)) >= 24] [contains(string(@ConstValue), ';') or contains(string(@ConstValue), '->') or contains(string(@ConstValue), '()')] [not(ancestor-or-self::* [ModifierList/Annotation[@SimpleName = 'AllowWeakTest'] [count(tokenize(normalize-space(.//MemberValuePair[@Image = 'reason']/StringLiteral/@ConstValue), ' ')) >= 20] [every $c in string-to-codepoints(string(.//MemberValuePair[@Image = 'reason']/StringLiteral/@ConstValue)) satisfies ($c >= 32 and $c <= 126)] [.//MemberValuePair[@Image = 'rules']//StringLiteral[string(@ConstValue) = 'TestAssertsSourceSnippet']]])] | //MethodCall[@MethodName = ('assertEquals', 'assertNotEquals')] /ArgumentList/*[position() <= 2]/descendant-or-self::StringLiteral [string-length(string(@ConstValue)) >= 24] [contains(string(@ConstValue), ';') or contains(string(@ConstValue), '->') or contains(string(@ConstValue), '()')] [not(ancestor-or-self::* [ModifierList/Annotation[@SimpleName = 'AllowWeakTest'] [count(tokenize(normalize-space(.//MemberValuePair[@Image = 'reason']/StringLiteral/@ConstValue), ' ')) >= 20] [every $c in string-to-codepoints(string(.//MemberValuePair[@Image = 'reason']/StringLiteral/@ConstValue)) satisfies ($c >= 32 and $c <= 126)] [.//MemberValuePair[@Image = 'rules']//StringLiteral[string(@ConstValue) = 'TestAssertsSourceSnippet']]])])
